name: Mac Control
description: Model-agnostic Mac automation through a Gateway-enforced user lease — screenshots, UI interaction, typing, apps, and windows via Peekaboo

configSchema.label: Max Screenshot Width
configSchema.description: Maximum pixel width for screenshots returned to agents (larger images are downscaled)

configSchema.label: Screenshot / Snapshot Directory
configSchema.description: Where peekaboo saves screenshots and UI-map snapshots. Use ~ for your home folder. Leave empty to use peekaboo's default (which is your Desktop).

configSchema.label: Snapshot Retention (days)
configSchema.description: Automatically delete screenshots and snapshots older than this many days. Set to 0 to disable cleanup.
